greeting: Good morning, Dan. A short review with Mike is the only thing holding today — beyond that, the calendar is open water and the Adriatic is right there.

needsAttention.title: Lock the Cavtat disembarkation
needsAttention.detail: The Sept 19 transfer from Komolac to Cavtat, the hotel bag hold, and the pre-dawn Sept 20 checkout still need arranging. Onboard signal thins fast, so it's easiest to settle while you're reachable.

needsAttention.title: Book the landing-week car and gap nights
needsAttention.detail: You land TPA Sept 20 with no car booked and the Sept 20-22 St Pete nights still open. Both are marked overdue and worth handling before connectivity fades.

flagged.title: New governance and AI-policy roles

inbox.noise: The rest is newsletters and shop sales - Fog Linen, OXO, NYT Cooking, Mattress Firm and the like.

acts.line: A 15-minute review with Mike at 9, then the morning opens to still water.
Nothing on the calendar holds the afternoon - day two of the charter is yours.
A clear evening ahead, with an equally open Monday behind it.
